checks.name: closed-downloadable-blob-contract

r=metadata({'id':'one','name':'one.mp4','mimeType':'video/mp4','size':'2','version':'1','md5Checksum':'a'*32,'trashed':False,'capabilities':{'canDownload':True}},'one')
